reason: On the Assign Team Lunch step, Tab reaches Next on the fourth stop, and both Enter and Space activate it: the dialog moves to the Set up budget cards step (the sampled state). Keyboard users can operate the trigger, so 2.1.1 does not fail; focus does drop to body after activation, but Back and Assign are reachable by Tab, and that is a different problem from the one reported.

The combobox carries autocomplete="garbage" next to the data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore attributes, a deliberate switch-off of browser autofill. The field picks which card a team member's budget spend comes from; it does not collect information about the user and serves none of the 1.3.5 input purposes. It exposes role combobox, its name and its expanded state to the accessibility tree.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in the WCAG input-purposes list (name, email, address, card number and so on). This field selects a card to link to a budget, so it has no such purpose and the invalid token takes nothing from users: nothing is left to identify. 4.1.2 is met: the accessibility tree gives the combobox its role, name Abigail Kyte and states (expanded=false, haspopup=listbox); an invalid autocomplete token changes none of them. 4.1.1 Parsing was removed in WCAG 2.2. No other A or AA criterion covers the attribute.
